html:
The Da Nang April 30 – May 1 holiday lasts for 5 days, so Da Nang is a destination chosen by many tourists during the holiday. This place not only has poetic beaches or famous landmarks, but when coming to Da Nang on the occasion of April 30 and May 1, tourists can also participate in attractive art activities taking place throughout the city.

The April 30 and May 1 holidays are also the occasion for Da Nang to begin the opening of the beach tourism season. This year’s beach tourism season begins on April 26 with the theme “Blue Wave Dance” taking place on all the beaches of Da Nang.

The event includes activities on the sea such as: “Overcoming the Summer Waves”, “Son Tra Moments”, live painting, Danang Color Race and beach sports such as football, beach rugby…

Artistic kite flying on the beach of Da Nang

The event will take place from 9am to 6pm from April 26 to the holiday at Da Nang East Sea Park, bringing people and tourists to watch colorful art performances in the sky of Da Nang.

In the sky of Da Nang with many colorful kites flying, there are kites designed in the shape of funny animals, looking like a colorful painting, this will be a unique vacation in Da Nang, reminding visitors of their childhood memories.

Lion Dance Festival at Da Nang Downtown

The festival takes place from May 1 to 3 at Sun Wheel Square, with the participation of 27 lion dance teams from all over the country, with the themes “night dragon light”, “lion earth treasure”, “mai hoa thung” and traditional lighting and sound techniques.

The festival includes circus magic performances, bartenders, folk games and night market ku along with 50 craft beer food stalls, allowing visitors to enjoy and capture beautiful moments.

The festival takes place on Than Tai Mountain

During the April 30 – May 1 holiday, many exciting activities take place at Than Tai Mountain Hot Spring Park to celebrate the big holiday. If you have the opportunity to travel Da Nang during the April 30 – May 1 holiday, visitors should visit and relax at Than Tai Mountain to join in the exciting festival events.

At Nui Than Tai, in addition to areas such as mineral baths, mud baths, water parks… visitors can also visit the bird garden – mushroom garden, love forest, picnic area and enjoy an attractive outdoor BBQ party.

In addition, visitors can also watch monkey circus, python circus, interact with parrots and check in with three-headed dinosaurs… promising to bring visitors the most memorable vacation.

Japanese festival in Da Nang Mikazuki

On the 30/4 – 1/5 holiday, at the Da Nang Mikazuki scenic area, there will be a fire dance, water music and brilliant fireworks show. On the night of the 30th, visitors will enjoy a seafood buffet with Japanese flavors, and receive sake as a gift…

Gifts on the 30/4 holiday at Ba Na Hills

At Ba Na Hills on the occasion of the 30/4 holiday, there are many sunflowers blooming, visitors will be satisfied to see the flowers blooming and check in for themselves beautiful pictures next to the flowers blooming under the golden sunshine.

Especially when traveling to Ba Na during the 30/4 – 1/5 holiday this year, visitors should wear red flag shirts with yellow stars to visit the wax museum and will be given 500ml of fresh beer…

So above are the exciting activities in Da Nang on April 30, please join Vietlook Travel on the Da Nang April 30 tour right on this occasion to immerse yourself in the events and festivals that this place brings to visitors.
